latest.title: Z-Deck 0.2.66

preUpdateBackup.reason: A/B app-only OTA does not write NVS, LittleFS, or SD; manual SD backup remains available as a separate queued action.

latest.notes: Refocuses the release around one reproducible source patch and six direct home controls. The updater validates size, MD5, and SHA-256 before activating the app. App-only A/B OTA never overwrites MeshCore, NVS, LittleFS, SD files, channels, keys, or local preferences.
